t: How to Buy Gifts That People Actually Want - Will Patrick
s: Gift-givers tend to believe that the more generous or pricey a gift is, the better it must be. This rarely works. For recipients, the absolute quality of the gift matters much more. This is equally true for something that the giver thinks is really thoughtful, too. This happens when we put an enormous amount of thought and money into a gift for a friend or relative, only to find that they have no interest in it. A good example of this might be picking up on someone's love for music and then buying them a beautiful acoustic guitar.
